options: A structured Excel workbook, published by Oracle, whose layout matches a specific interface table
A random spreadsheet any user creates from scratch
A PDF form
A SQL script
questions.explain: Oracle publishes a specific template workbook per business object, with a layout built to match the interface table it feeds.

questions.q: What does the Instructions tab of an FBDI template typically contain?
options: The final live data once the import completes
A password required to open the file
An explanation of the template, prerequisites, and the macro button used to generate CSV files
A list of unrelated Oracle products
questions.explain: The Instructions tab explains the template's purpose and holds the macro that converts populated data tabs into CSV files.

questions.q: Why does a Payables Invoice Import template have separate tabs for invoice headers and invoice lines?
options: Purely for visual decoration
It doesn't — headers and lines are always on the same tab
Because Excel cannot hold more than 10 columns per tab
Because headers and lines live in two different interface tables, and each tab matches one table
questions.explain: Each data tab corresponds to one interface table. Invoice headers and invoice lines are separate tables, so they get separate tabs.

questions.q: Why should you never insert, delete, or reorder columns on an FBDI template's data tab?
options: Because Excel will crash if you do
Because the column headers are literal interface-table column names, and rearranging them breaks the mapping between spreadsheet and database columns
Because Oracle charges a fee for each column changed
There is no actual risk in doing this
questions.explain: A template's columns map one-to-one onto an interface table's columns. Changing their order or set breaks that direct mapping.

questions.q: What is the correct way to choose which FBDI template to use for a given job?
options: Match the template name to the specific interface table and downstream import process you intend to run
Pick whichever template has the shortest file name
Use the same template for every type of data
It doesn't matter — any template can load any kind of data
questions.explain: Each template targets a specific interface table and a specific import process. Using the wrong template means the data won't match the process you planned to run.
